findings.title: Check session usability before switching models
findings.description: After a reconnect fails, `_reconnect` records `unusable_reason` and leaves the session with a client that did not connect. `set_model()` does not check that state, but the session dispatch path calls it before `dispatch()` performs its usability check. A later step can therefore send a model-switch request to the known-unusable client instead of failing immediately with the recorded reason.

findings.title: Do not report failed stop requests as stopped tasks
findings.description: When `stop_task()` raises, the method logs the error but still clears the ledger and sets `background_tasks_stopped` to the number of tasks attempted. The dispatch metadata can therefore claim agents were stopped when their stop requests failed; those agents may still be running while subsequent pipeline steps proceed.

findings.title: Add a load test for background-agent waiting
findings.description: This adds asynchronous SDK-stream waiting, idle timeouts, and task-stop requests on a network path. The new tests in `tests/pipeline/test_sdk_session.py` use scripted clients, but there is no load test exercising this path under a realistic configuration and asserting latency, throughput, or resource bounds, as required for network and concurrency paths.
